definitions.explanation: An anticipated outcome or likely result of something.
A target or goal to aim for, often in terms of time or quantity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目処|めど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目処|めど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかない。
examples.english: There's no prospect of a solution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる{目処|めど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{立|た}っていない→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: There's still no prospect of when the construction will finish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目処|めど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦{安心|あんしん}した→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧。
examples.english: I was relieved when I had a prospect of finding a job.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退院|たいいん}→退院：02090_taiin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目処|めど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}た→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ず、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}している→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧。
examples.english: With no prospect of being discharged, the family is worried.

examples.japanese: 3⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{目処|めど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I'll move with March as my target.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{末|まつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{目処|めど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: We'll finish with the end of next month as the target.
I'm saving with one million yen as my goal.

notes:
ALTERNATE KANJI:
Also written as ⟦{目途|めど}→目途：17245_medo⟧, though {目処|めど} is more common.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {目処|めど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ - to have a prospect (positive)
- {目処|めど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく - to see a prospect
- {目処|めど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかない - to have no prospect
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{目処|めど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - with ~ as the target

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧ - outlook, perspective
- ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧ - goal, target
- ⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧ - prospect, expectation

USAGE:
Commonly used in business and project planning contexts.
